hard_negative_guard: No Fourier/projection power, periodic mask, lag scan, phase/reset variant, or repeating carrier test is permitted for 761, 1033, or 3301.
address_rule: A transformed value selects at most one anchor in each target unit. Bounded returns NA outside 1..L. Wrapped returns 1+((t-1) mod L). Reverse maps a to L+1-a.
strong_boundary: Immediately adjacent in canonical source to period, paragraph, page, section, or corpus-end mark. Word separators and transcription-only line slashes are diagnostic only and are not scored.

controls.structured_number_family: Preserve digit scale, the 29/58 doubling relationship, reversal-pair structure, and observed prime/composite vector.
controls.within_unit: Independent circular shifts of rune labels relative to fixed mark and unit geometry.
controls.state_residues: Sample seven distinct residues from 0..28 and compare with the fixed seven unique selector residues.

family_correction: For each control, standardize every frozen cell by its discovery-null mean and standard deviation, then use the maximum standardized statistic over the complete family (single-step maxT).
promotion: An exact discovery cell must have FWER p<=0.05 under both relevant controls. It advances unchanged and must achieve held-out FWER p<=0.05 under both controls with the same effect direction. Page36-only evidence cannot promote.
page36_status: Sealed until discovery finishes; corroborative/descriptive only because it has no discovery counterpart. 91=7x13 is observation only and creates no transform or reading order.
plaintext_policy: No plaintext generation, language scoring, solved-text prior, prime-clause oracle, or semantic interpretation.
